Answer: A
Reason: The CT images (Figures 1-4) demonstrate an endobronchial mass in the right upper lobe bronchus causing partial obstruction, which has led to post-obstructive pneumonitis characterized by patchy consolidation and air trapping rather than complete homogeneous atelectasis. This radiographic presentation of a central obstructing lesion with distal inflammatory changes is classic for a bronchial carcinoid tumor.
